frontier.observed: The Kata reference StatefulSet runs ClayVerse as uid/gid 10001 and mounts persistent PVCs over /var/lib/clayverse and /workspace, but the Pod securityContext previously did not request an fsGroup.
frontier.hypothesis: A newly provisioned or differently provisioned persistent volume can mask image-time ownership and be unwritable to the non-root ClayVerse process, preventing UnifiedDB/workspace startup or recovery.
frontier.counterhypothesis: A target CSI/storage implementation may independently mount the PVC with compatible ownership, so the missing fsGroup would not fail on every cluster.
frontier.discriminator: Require an explicit non-root mount-group contract in the deployment source and final acceptance, then prove create/write/fsync/read/rename/delete as uid=10001,gid=10001 on both persistent mounts before and after full appliance replacement.

changes: no privileged/root init-container ownership repair path
contract requires storage-class/CSI identity and effective mount-group proof
contract requires uid/gid 10001 create/write/fsync/read/rename/delete probes on state and workspace, repeated after full appliance replacement

primary_upstream_evidence.source: Kubernetes official documentation: Configure a Security Context for a Pod or Container and Pod v1 API
supported_claims: fsGroup applies a supplemental group and supported volume ownership/write semantics
when fsGroup is unset, kubelet does not modify volume ownership and permissions
fsGroupChangePolicy OnRootMismatch bounds recursive ownership changes
CSI VOLUME_MOUNT_GROUP may delegate mount-group handling to the CSI driver

supporting_probe.environment: isolated local reconstruction; not product runtime
limitations: reconstructed source probe, not exact Git blob pytest

unusual_experiment.reason: No safely shared immutable request/turn identity is exposed; only minute-precision trigger time is available.

next_gate: Run exact branch regression in an admitted isolated executor, then build the exact final OCI image and prove non-root persistent-volume behavior under the admitted Kata/equivalent runtime and storage class/CSI before whole-product acceptance.
